data.name: Hadaaqah
data.gender_notes: Hadaaqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A precious gift or reward from Allah. The name Hadaaqah carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hadaaqah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hadaaqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Reward.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hadaaqah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: حداقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل هدى، ويعني الهداية والرشاد، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدُوا إِلَى أَحسَنِ الأَخلاقِ ، ويستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يهدي الناس إلى الطريق الصحيح.

in_urdu.name: حداقہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک نام جو ہدایت اور رہنمائی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی मूल کا ایک علم نام، جس کا مطلب ہے ہدایت اور رہنمائی، عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، خاص طور پر فعل ہدٰی سے، جو قرآن کریم میں کئی آیات میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جیسے: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدُوا إِلَى أَحسَنِ الأَخلاقِ ، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک رہنما کے طور پر استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو لوگوں کو صحیح راستے پر لے جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: हदाक़ा
in_hindi.meaning: एक नाम जो मार्गदर्शन और नेतृत्व की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मार्गदर्शन और नेतृत्व, यह नाम अरबी मूल के क्रिया हदٰ से लिया गया है, जो कुरआन में कई स्थानों पर वर्णित है, जैसे: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدُوا إِلَى أَحسَنِ الأَخلاقِ , यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक मार्गदर्शक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है जो लोगों को सही रास्ते पर ले जाता है.

in_pashto.name: حداقہ
in_pashto.meaning: د يو نوم چې د لارښوونې او هدايت په معنا دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عربي اصلي يو علم نوم، چي د هدايت او لارښوونې معنی لري، د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، په ځانګړي ډول د هډی فعل څخه، چي په قرآن کریم کې په ډیرو ایتونو کې راغلی دی، لکه: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدُوا إِلَى أَحسَنِ الأَخلاقِ ، په افغان او پښتني دود کې د يو لارښود په توګه کارول کیږي چي خلک سمې لارې ته بوځي.

in_english.name: Hadaaqah
in_english.meaning: A name signifying guidance and righteousness
in_english.long_meaning: A feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'hada', meaning guidance and righteousness, referenced in several verses of the Quran, such as: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدُوا إِلَى أَحسَنِ الأَخلاقِ , used across Islamic cultures to denote a guide who leads people to the right path, symbolizing spiritual direction and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The Arabic name "Hadaaqah" is rooted in the Islamic culture, connoting the idea of a valuable gift or reward. It is often used in the context of blessings, favors, and generosity, and is a reminder of the abundant gifts and blessings we receive from Allah in our daily lives. This name may also be reflected in various aspects of Islamic art, literature, and music. For example, the Persian poet Rumi once wrote, "Seek out the hidden treasures in the heart of the Beloved, for they are more precious than a mountain of gold and a mine of precious stones." In this way, "Hadaaqah" serves as a reminder of the spiritual and eternal rewards that come from seeking Allah and following the path of righteousness.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, "Hadaaqah" signifies a precious gift or reward bestowed upon an individual by Allah. This gift may take the form of spiritual guidance, inner peace, or the attainment of a lofty goal, such as experiencing closeness to the Divine. In the hadith literature, Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) describes the blessings of faith and righteousness as a never-ending source of joy and happiness in this life and the next. He said, "The Paradise is under the shade of the Throne of Allah, and the best thing in it is the companionship of Allah, so the servants will not cease to enter Paradise until its gates are closed." Thus, "Hadaaqah" is a reminder of the infinite blessings and rewards that await those who seek Allah and lead a virtuous life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gift, Reward" symbolizes A precious gift or reward from Allah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Hadaaqah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gift, reward.
